notes.title: ❤ Valentine's Update! ❤
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44979958/0d02204cc5cbb4f9324df89954b9730ada61db1d.png[/img]
Show your farm (and your pets) some love with the newest update! Your animals can now gain heart levels when you solve puzzles, feed them "Heart Candy", or while giving them their daily pets!

Also, eight puzzles in total have been added to the demo, each with a gradual difficulty curve!

notes.title: Sudoku Acres demo release!
notes.notes:
Welcome to Sudoku Acres, a cozy cross-up of farm building and puzzle solving. Watch your skills grow with your environment as you complete sudoku puzzles, bring in new animal friends, and unlock decorations for your farm!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44979958/cce9575b83dbdcd1ccfe3aaa92bb0ddeb13621ae.png[/img]

See that cow above? You'll have to wait for the final version to invite them onto your farm :)

This demo comes with five puzzles and a limited number of available pets and items - hopefully enough to give you a feel for the game! You'll have much more options in the full release, plus new features like changing the time of day, weather, and seasons.

Thanks to everyone in the discord who was able to beta test!
